topic.desc: Claude for Government: Overview (Claude for Government), Tenant admin, Org admin, Config, Security, Deploy desktop, Microsoft 365 and Claude Code, Desktop, Account.

concepts: Overview (Claude for Government): Claude for Government administrator guide, Moving from Claude for Government Web, Video walkthroughs for administrators, Claude for Government changelog.
Tenant admin: Tenant administration, Tenant setup wizard, Readiness, Organizations, Identity and access, Tenant restrictions, Seats, Billing, Config at the tenant level, Admins.
Org admin: Organization administration, Setup wizard, Readiness, Users, Seats, Seat tiers, Group mappings, Analytics, Compliance API, Billing, Config at the organization level.
Config: How Config works, Available settings, Manage plugins and connectors, Connectors, Set up the Microsoft 365 connector.
Deploy desktop, Microsoft 365 and Claude Code

Deploy desktop, Microsoft 365 and Claude Code: Connect Claude Desktop to Claude for Government, Windows fleet checklist, Deploy Claude for Microsoft 365 in Claude for Government, Connect Claude Code to Claude for Government.
Desktop: Video walkthroughs for Claude Desktop, Import your data from Claude for Government Web, Plugins in Claude Desktop, Skills in Claude Desktop, Models in Claude Desktop.
Account: Your account, Account, Usage, Sessions.
skills: Set up and manage Claude for Government for your agency: how tenants, organizations, users, seats, and credits fit together.
Moving from Claude for Government Web
Find answers to the questions agencies ask most often when moving from Claude for Government Web to Claude Desktop.
Watch short narrated walkthroughs of setting up and running Claude for Government for your agency.
Release notes for Claude for Government
Manage the settings that apply across your whole agency: organizations, identity and sign-in, and how seats are distributed and spend caps are set.
Set up a new tenant in order: verify a domain, connect single sign-on, add an organization, give it seats, and add the routing rule that lets people sign in.
Readiness checks for your tenant and its organizations: what the checks on domains, routing rules, sign-in failures, and billing mean, and who clears them.
See every organization in your tenant, open an organization's admin view, add an organization and get it ready for people, and copy user email addresses.
Verify domains, connect single sign-on and SCIM, write the routing rules that place people in organizations, and look up what a sign-in error page means.
Restrict which Claude for Government tenants can be reached from your agency's network by having your network proxy inject an allowlist header.
Divide each billing account's seat pool among the organizations it funds, and see who can change an allocation and why a change is refused.
See each billing account's credit balance and set per-organization spend caps, with what a cap counts, what it stops, and when a change takes effect.
Set tenant-wide defaults for product behavior, lock settings so organizations can't change them, and preview how a change affects each organization.
Tenant administrator access: what it grants, who can be added, how to add or remove an administrator, and the safeguards on the list.
Manage the people, seats, and settings for a single organization within your agency: users, roles, seat tiers, usage, billing, and Config.
Setup wizard for a new organization: how to open it, and what the seat tiers, seats and credits, products, and finish steps cover.
Readiness checks for your organization: what the checks on credits, spend caps, seats, seat tiers, models, and products mean, and who can clear each one.
Find a user, change their role or seat tier, sign them out everywhere, deactivate or reactivate them, reset their usage limits, and see what each role can do.
See how many seats of each tier your organization holds and how many are assigned, and how new and unassigned users get a seat tier.
Seat tiers set which Claude models a user can access and how much they can spend. Organization owners create and manage their own seat tiers.
Map directory groups to seat tiers and roles in your organization, and see how mappings are applied and what a deactivation in your directory does.
Review your organization's requests, tokens, spend, active users, top users, and credit balance over time, and download the data as CSV files for reporting.
Stream your organization's audit events into a SIEM or log management system.
See the balance your organization spends from, the spend caps set on it, and its seats, and what happens as the billing account's balance runs low.
Set product settings for everyone in your organization on the Config page, and see how connectors and plugins inherited from your tenant behave there.
Config levels in Claude for Government: how tenant, directory group, and organization settings combine, what locks do, and when changes reach members.
Config page settings in Claude for Government, such as session timeouts, network and folder access, tool approvals, connectors, plugins, telemetry, and updates.
Upload plugins and skills in Claude for Government: archive rules, size limits, the Runs code marker, install behavior, updates, and removal.
Connectors let tenant administrators and organization owners add their agency's MCP servers: who gets them, authentication, OAuth redirect URIs, tool policy.
Register a Microsoft Entra application for the Microsoft 365 connector in Claude Desktop, choose its read and write permissions, and fix sign-in errors.
Review how Claude for Government handles data: sandbox isolation, network traffic, approvals, connector credentials, telemetry, web search, and local storage.
Connect Claude Desktop to Claude for Government
Connect Claude Desktop to Claude for Government: the bootstrap URL, device profiles for macOS, Windows, and Linux, network hosts, updates, and troubleshooting.
Windows device, MSIX installer, application control, and virtualization checks to make before you deploy Claude Desktop for Claude for Government.
Deploy Claude for Microsoft 365 in Claude for Government
Download the Claude for Microsoft 365 manifest from your Claude for Government host and deploy the add-in to users from the Microsoft 365 admin center.
Connect Claude Code to Claude for Government
Connect the Claude Code command-line tool to Claude for Government with managed settings on macOS, Windows, and Linux, and confirm a device is set up.
Watch short narrated walkthroughs of signing in to Claude Desktop with Claude for Government, bringing your work over, and finding your way around the app.
Import your data from Claude for Government Web
Copy your conversations, projects, and files from Claude for Government Web into Claude Desktop, or move your Claude Desktop data to another computer.
Find, install, create, and remove plugins in Claude Desktop for Claude for Government, and understand what plugins add in this deployment.
Skills in Claude Desktop for Claude for Government: where they come from, how to create and manage your own, and how administrators distribute them.
Switch models in Claude Desktop on Claude for Government, see what the 1M context window does, and find what controls which models you see.
Check your own account details, usage limits, and active sessions in the Claude for Government web portal.
Check the email, organization, role, and seat tier on your Claude for Government account, who to ask to change each one, and what to do with no seat.
Check how much of your Claude allowance you have used and when it resets, and what to do when you hit a usage limit or your organization runs out of credits.
See every place you are signed in to Claude for Government, sign any of them out, and check how long sessions last and what ends them.
